rationale: Explicit stratified coverage sample: five distinct identities from each of eight packs, selected from the measured inventory. This is a technical pilot, not a random sample, visual approval, or relevance benchmark. Retain paired named variants and repeated food names across authors; include roads, vehicles, furniture, trees, material/texture references, all six observed model formats, supplied individual views and assets without them. Reproduce by exact pack and source-relative identity, never by a filename-only lookup.
